nodes.label: Playwright Root Dependency Restriction
nodes.rationale: Playwright/playwright-core and @sparticuz/chromium must never be added to the root package.json; they live only in infra/browser-worker/package.json so the main Next.js app bundle and build stay free of Playwright's native browser binaries, keeping deploys to Vercel lightweight and reserving heavy browser automation for the self-hosted worker.

nodes.label: Legacy Reference Rule
nodes.rationale: The legacy Python/LangGraph implementation (University_Validation(20-07)) should be referenced only to extract business requirements (scraper API specs, statutory body list, categorization logic, abbreviation dictionary, DigiLocker semantics, duplicate detection weights) and never to copy its architecture (Python code structure, LangGraph workflow, FastAPI patterns, or 3-table schema), so the new system can use modern TypeScript patterns (Result type, AppError hierarchy, unified schema) instead of inheriting legacy design debt.
